Commentary.Commentary: What a game we are witnessing here! India Women have managed to take this game to the SUPER OVER! This is their first-ever tied match and they have pushed their formidable opponents to the brink. Australia Women would be really disappointed that they were unable to restrict the hosts. The game continues to provide us with further thrills as Richa Ghosh and Smriti Mandhana make their way out to face six crucial deliveries. Heather Graham has been handed the ball and will are all set for the deciding overs.

FOUR! Yes she can, Devika Vaidya finds the fence! It is a tie! This game is going to a Super-Over! Megan Schutt bowls this on a yorker length and outside off, Devika Vaidya squeezes it between point and short third man for a boundary.

Megan Schutt bowls a brilliant yorker, on middle, Richa Ghosh squeezes it towards mid off for a single. India Women need a six for a win and four for a tie now. Can Devika Vaidya do something special?
A low full toss, on middle, Richa Ghosh lofts it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Six needed in two balls now!
Full and on off, Devika Vaidya drives it towards long off for a single.

EDGED AND FOUR! Just what India Women needed! This is full and outside off, Devika Vaidya skips down the track and slashes, but gets a outside edge past the keeper towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Megan Schutt nails the yorker, on off, Richa Ghosh drills it towards covers and takes the single. She is off strike now.
Fuller one and on off, Richa Ghosh swings hard at it, but gets a top edge over short third man for a single. Richa Ghosh will be on strike and India Women needs 14 runs in the last over.
This is short and going down leg, Devika Vaidya pulls this down to fine leg and takes a single.
Goes full once again and outside off, Richa Ghosh thumps this back towards the bowler who allows the ball to go through her legs and they take one.
Heather Graham bowls a slower delivery full and outside off, Devika Vaidya hits this into the air as she is early into the shot and just manages to clear the infield. A single is taken.
Devika Vaidya is the new batter out in the middle and her role will be to get Richa Ghosh the strike.

OUT! TAKEN! A great catch in the deep! Heather Graham gets her third wicket! She bowls the slower delivery again, on a length and on leg, Deepti Sharma scoops it uppishly towards the fine leg region where Alana King runs forward to take an excellent catch. Australia Women breaks the partnership and it is now on Richa Ghosh to take her side home.
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Heather Graham

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one, on a length and on leg, Deepti Sharma scoops it with the inner half, but Alyssa Healy behinds the stumps moves to her right to collect it.
Short again and on off, Deepti Sharma pulls it over mid-wicket for another run. 18 runs needed in 12 balls now. This is going down to the wire!
Short and on middle, Richa Ghosh slaps it towards long on for a single.
SIX! Richa Ghosh goes back again! She is turning on the heat here! This is quicker, full and outside off, Richa Ghosh uses here reach and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
A low full toss, on off, Richa Ghosh loses her grip and knocks it towards point.
Flatter, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! MASSIVE! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh moves across a bit, goes down on her knees and slogs it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Full and on the pads, Richa Ghosh nudges it towards short fine leg for a single. India Women need 32 runs in 18 balls now!

SIX! Richa Ghosh has been sent to do exactly this! Annabel Sutherland bowls a low full toss outside off, Richa Ghosh swings and connects cleanly. The ball flies high over the bowler's head for a biggie! 33 runs needed in 19 balls.
Annabel Sutherland bowls this on a fuller length and outside off, Deepti Sharma strokes this to deep cover and gets off the mark with a single.
Deepti Sharma has been sent up the order and she makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Annabel Sutherland gets the prized scalp! Smriti Mandhana goes back to the hut now, and India Women is in a spot of bother. Annabel Sutherland bowls this on good length and on off, Smriti Mandhana moves across to play the scoop, but gets a bottom edge and the ball goes onto disturb the stumps. Smriti Mandhana is very annoyed with herself as she was set and could have stayed there till the end.
SIX! BOOM! A much-needed boundary for India Women! This is short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana stays there and slaps it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Annabel Sutherland bowls this on a hard length and around off, Smriti Mandhana looks to cut it away, but gets beaten by the extra bounce. Alyssa Healy does well to stop it behind the stumps.
A brilliant yorker, on middle, Richa Ghosh manages to keep it out. 46 runs needed in 24 balls now!
Richa Ghosh has been sent to finish this run chase for India Women. Can she do it?

OUT! TAKEN! Harmanpreet Kaur's struggling knock comes to an end! Heather Graham bowls a low full toss, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down and slogs well and aerially, but straight into the hands of Beth Mooney at deep mid-wicket who makes no mistake. A crucial moment in the game as India Women loses their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Heather Graham

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur guides it towards short third man. A valuable dot for the Aussies.
Goes fuller and on middle, Smriti Mandhana slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Back of a length and on leg, Smriti Mandhana clips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Smriti Mandhana is playing a blinder here! This is short of a length and around leg, Smriti Mandhana clears here front leg and heaves it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Heather Graham replaces Megan Schutt.
Bowls this one slightly short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur cuts this hard but finds the point fielder who makes a good stop diving to her left.
Continues to bowl on a good length but this time outside off, Smriti Mandhana mistimes her pull shot wide of long on and they take a single.
On a good length and follows the batter down leg side as Smriti Mandhana looks to make room. Hits this uppishly towards cover.
Bowls this one back of a length and in line with the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this towards deep square leg and takes a single.

FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur joins the party and brings up the 50-run partnership! Kim Garth bowls this full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur heaves this towards the cow corner fence and collects four runs.
Kim Garth bowls this on a good length and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches this to cover and it will be a dot ball.
Kim Garth (3-0-27-0) to bowl out now.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for India Women but they will be happy with it! Megan Schutt goes really full and outside the off pole, Smriti Mandhana looks to dig this out but gets a thick edge that flies to the third man fence for four runs.
SIX! That has cleared the ropes by some distance! Megan Schutt continues to bowl this back of a length and in line with the stumps. Smriti Mandhana pulls this over deep square leg for a maximum.
This is short and outside the off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this one full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana strokes this to deep cover and takes a single.
Bowls this on a good length and pitching outside leg stump. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull this across the line but misses and the ball goes off the pads towards third man. They take two leg byes.
Megan Schutt bowls this full and into the stumps, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.
Megan Schutt comes back into the attack, She has conceded 17 runs in her first two overs.

FOUR! That is FIFTY for Smriti Mandhana! This is full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana sweeps this towards deep square leg and finds the gap to collect four more runs. She has been absolutely wonderful in this inning and a lot depends on her if India Women want to get over the finish line.

SIX! Another full toss and Smriti Mandhana does not miss out on putting this away! Alana King loops this on a leg stump line, Smriti Mandhana is down the wicket and hoicks this over deep square leg for a biggie.
This is bowled slightly short and in line with the stumps, much quicker through the air. Harmanpreet Kaur goes back in the crease and manages to get this to deep square leg for a single.
This one is full as well but straying down leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur goes on one knee and looks to slog this but misses and gest hit on the pads.
Bowls a loopy delivery full and wide outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur loses her shape as she charges down and inside edges the ball to the leg side.
Bowls a high full toss wide outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur charges down the wicket but misses out as she finds the cover fielder with her shot.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana brings up the 100 for India Women in a good-looking fashion! Kim Garth serves this one full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the wicket and lofts the ball over the infield to find the long off fence for four runs.
Delivers this one slightly shot and going towards leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge to the left of the bowler.
Goes 'round the wicket to the southpaw and bowls this full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana strokes this firmly to deep cover for a single.
On a good length and in line with the stumps, bowled much slower in the air. Harmanpreet Kaur tucks this towards deep square leg and takes one.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur gets on her knee and looks to paddle this but misses.
WIDE! Kim Garth starts the over with a full delivery going down leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick and the umpire calls this wide.
Kim Garth (2-0-19-0) is back on.
Bowls this one slightly short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana taps this towards the point fielder to end the over with a dot ball. 95 runs are needed in 54 balls.
This is full as well and slower in the air, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur taps this into the off side with soft hands and takes a quick single.
SIX! This has been dispatched! Ashleigh Gardner floats this one full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur slog sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Drifting into the stumps on a fuller length, Harmanpreet Kaur clips this uppishly towards mid-wicket and the ball falls short of the fielder.
FOUR! Finds the gap to perfection! Ashleigh Gardner bowls this full and wide outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur carves this towards deep point and collects four runs.
Ashleigh Gardner starts the over with a loopy delivery full and in line with the stumps. Smriti Mandhana strokes this towards long off for a single.
Goes fuller this time and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it back to the bowler.
On a length and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Harmanpreet Kaur the captain of India Women strides out to the crease.

OUT! LBW! Heather Graham strikes now! Australia Women gets two wickets in two overs, and they are right back in the game now. Heather Graham bowls this on a good length and on middle, shaping in a bit, Jemimah Rodrigues looks work it away, but plays down the wrong line and gets rapped around the pads right in front of the stumps. There is an appeal for LBW, and up goes the finger. Jemimah Rodrigues walks back in disappointment. India Women lose their second.
Pitched up, full and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it back to the bowler.
Heather Graham bangs this short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
This is full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana blocks it down the pitch.
Bowls this one full and drifting into the stumps, Jemimah Rodrigues clips this towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues is off the mark with a boundary! Alana King bowls this short and straying onto the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues rocks back and pulls this towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Jemimah Rodrigues makes her way out at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Alana King provides the breakthrough! The bowling change has worked for Australia Women. Alana King bowls this short again and outside off, turning away, Shafali Verma looks to clear the in field on the off side, but mistimes her heave into the air towards covers where Tahlia McGrath takes a simple catch. Shafali Verma goes after playing a blistering knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Alana King

Commentary.Commentary: Quciker one, short and on middle, angling in, Shafali Verma looks to block it out, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Short again and on middle, Shafali Verma mistimes here push back towards the bowler.
Flatter, short and down the leg side, Shafali Verma misses her pull shot. Wided.
Alana King starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards long off for a single.
Alana King has been brought into the attack and Australia Women will be hoping she can get them a breakthrough.
Length again and on off, Smriti Mandhana finds the gap this time through covers for a single.
On a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana plays it towards cover-point.
Short of a length and on off, Shafali Verma eases it towards long off for a single. Sensible batting!
SIX! BANG! Shafali Verma clears the ropes! Megan Schutt lands this short and on middle, Shafali Verma pulls it hard and over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Back of a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it through covers for a single.
This is on a good length and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards point.
A bit short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana works it towards deep backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana finds the gap! This is tossed up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana swats it past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
Flighted, full and on middle, Shafali Verma forces it towards long on for one more.
Floated, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it towards long off for a run.
Quicker, full and on middle, Shafali Verma drills it past the bowler for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shafali Verma chips it towards wide of long on where Megan Schutt dives to here left to keep it in. Two runs taken!
FOUR! Nice timing! This is short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana stays there and punches it past covers for a boundary. India Women are 55 for no loss after the Powerplay.
Short and on middle, Shafali Verma pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.

Great effort in the deep! This is full again and on middle, Smriti Mandhana heaves it aerielly towards deep mid-wicket where Ashleigh Gardner dives froward to take the catch, but takes it on the bounce. A single is taken.
FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues is off the mark in style!
Full again and on leg, Shafali Verma lofts it with the inner half past mid-wicket for a run.
Heather Graham starts with a full delivery, on the pads, Smriti Mandhana flicks it through square leg for a single.
Heather Graham comes into the attack now.
This is bowled back of a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana pulls this to deep square leg and takes a single to keep strike. 16 runs from the over and a good one for India Women.

DROPPED! A chance goes begging for Australia Women to get the breakthrough! Ellyse Perry continues to persist with the short ball and serves this well outside off, Shafali Verma looks to hit this uppishly square of the wicket but is early into the shot. The ball loops up towards Megan Schutt at deep cover who gets low to take the catch but spills it. A massive let off for Shafali Verma and how expensive will it prove to be for the visitors?
FOUR! Shafali Verma is getting a move on now! This is short as well and outside the off stump, Shafali Verma cross bats this past the diving mid off fielder and adds four more runs to her kitty.
FOUR! This has been slapped away! Ellyse Perry bowls this short and wide outside off, Shafali Verma cuts this hard towards deep point and collects four runs.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shafali Verma hits this hard on the up but finds the mid off fielder.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for India Women! Ellyse Perry bowls this back of a length and way down leg side. Shafali Verma is nowhere near the ball and Alyssa Healy can not stop the ball as well. The umpire calls wide and five extra runs are added to the tally.
Ellyse Perry starts off with a short ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana mistimes her pull into the mid-wicket region and takes a single.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Kim Garth bangs this in short and outside off, Shafali Verma pulls this wide of long on and the ball lands just out of the reach of the diving fielder. Goes over the ropes for four runs.
Goes a touch fuller and outside the off pole, Shafali Verma knocks this hard but finds mid off this time.
On a good length once again and outside off, Shafali Verma pushes this towards the cover fielder.
WIDE! Kim Garth angles this one down leg on a fuller length, Shafali Verma looks to clip this fine but misses, and the umpire calls this wide.
Bowls this on slightly short and outside the off stump, Smriti Mandhana pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana blocks this towards cover.
Kim Garth bowls this on a good length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana taps this towards the point fielder.
FOUR! Connects this one cleanly! Another full delivery bowled outside the off pole, Shafali Verma hits through the line and over the bowler's head for her first boundary.
Goes full and outside the off stump, Shafali Verma miscues her shot high into9 the air and just manages to land beyond the back-tracking mid-off fielder. They take a couple of runs.
This is slightly fuller and outside off, Shafali Verma punches this straight to cover.
Bowls this one short and outside off, Shafali Verma mistimes her pull and the ball lands just short of mid-wicket.
On a good length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana strokes this to deep cover for a single.
Megan Schutt bowls a short ball outside off to begin. Shafali Verma pulls this firmly towards deep mid-wicket and takes one.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and Smriti Mandhana is getting a move on here! Kim Garth bowls this full and just outside off, Smriti Mandhana makes room and swings her bat. Gets the ball to deep cover point and collects another four runs. 13 runs have come from this over.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana pushes at the ball and gets an inside edge towards backward square leg.

FOUR! An old-fashioned hoick from Smriti Mandhana! This is bowled slightly fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana lifts this over the infield and gets the ball to the long on fence for another boundary.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana looking to be positive here! Kim Garth bowls this on a good length but strays onto the pads. Smriti Mandhana pulls this towards deep square leg and beats the fielder for four runs.
On a good length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana knocks this towards the cover fielder.
Kim Garth begins with a full ball just outside off, Shafali Verma clips this to the right of mid-wicket and takes a run to get off the mark.
Kim Garth to bowl from the other end.
Bowls this full as well and outside off, Smriti Mandhana taps this towards cover-point and looks for a quick single which they do not take. Four runs from the first over.
This is slightly short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana goes back in the crease and clocks this awkwardly toward the off side. Some turn and bounce on offer.
FOUR! First boundary for India Women! Ashleigh Gardner floast this one full and outside the off pole. Smriti Mandhana slog sweeps this wide of deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with four runs.
Slightly short and just outside off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back onto her back foot and punches the ball towards cover-point.
Flighted ball bowled full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana hits this uppishly towards cover.
Ashleigh Gardner starts off with a really full delivery on a leg stump line. Smriti Mandhana knocks this back towards the bowler.
